report.summary: Four files modified across the two rounds: exporters/export_board.py, tests/test_export_board.py, CLAUDE.md and local/tests/test_conformance.py. Round 2 changed only the one approved conformance test, 21 lines added and 1 removed. Round 1's exporter change was re-checked against every criterion and needed no edit. Suites, run from the worktree on the working tree: python -m unittest discover -s tests ran 271, all passed (OK); node tests/page.test.mjs passed all 68 page checks, exit 0; python -m unittest discover -s local/tests ran 90, all passed (OK), the count unchanged. changes.why: Round 1, unchanged in round 2. New carried(raw, since) marks the kept file. On the first carry it parses the file, adds carriedSince and re-serialises it the way main() writes a rebuilt tab (ensure_ascii=False, indent=1). A file that already has the marker is returned as its exact bytes, which keeps later runs byte-identical. So is a file that is not a UTF-8 JSON object, which stops a corrupt kept file from failing every project's export. main() derives since from the existing run stamp (the now parameter, else datetime.now(timezone.utc)) in UTC with a Z. Rebuilt tabs never go through carried(). The stderr warning text is unchanged, and the module docstring was updated.

Round 1. Repos.run takes an optional now so tests control the run time, and the constants NOW_Z, CARRIED, CARRIED_Z and LATEST were added. Four tests added, red first: the marker is set, cleared on recovery, never on a normal tab, and a kept file that is not a JSON object is left as it was. MissingSources.test_kept_tabs_are_byte_identical was rewritten to state stable-while-carried and now covers every tab. The two keep-last tests that compare parsed documents now expect the prior document plus carriedSince, by exact equality.

Round 1. Both keep-last sentences now name carriedSince and say when it is set and cleared: the one in the projectTabs store-table row, and the Refresh procedure's export_board bullet. It is written in UTC with a Z, set on the first run that keeps the tab (one push), left byte for byte while the source stays missing, dropped once the source comes back, and never on a normally exported tab.

Round 2, the one approved local/ change. Only ConformanceV1.test_alpha_tabs_are_the_ones_export_board_kept changed. The old line 403 asserted the first carry is byte-identical to the original export (FR-153's old contract). Now each alpha tab after the carry must parse to exactly its first export plus carriedSince '2026-09-11T12:00:00Z', the Z form of the fixture's NOW, and the first export must not already have the marker. export_board then runs once more at a later time (2026-09-12T09:00:00+00:00, alpha still moved) and the kept bytes must equal the previous run's. That third run works on a copy of out/projectTabs, the only part of out/ that export_board reads, so the out/ the class's other tests share is left alone. The stderr check, the expected tab set, and the beta and gamma checks are kept as they were. The Fixture, local/records*, local/schema* and local/records.shapes.json are untouched.
acceptance_refs: Local conformance test updated, not weakened

tests.covers: FR-190 in the conformance suite. It asserts the carried alpha tabs equal their first export plus carriedSince (NOW in Z form), and that a further carry at a later time is byte-identical to the previous run. The mutation check shows both asserts bite: keeping the old raw bytes fails the parse-equality check on alpha.assumptions.json, re-stamping every run fails the byte check, and the real exporter passes.
AC-125: every kept tab equals its last export plus carriedSince, in the Z form of the carrying run's time. The stderr warning is unchanged.
Stable while carried: the first carry equals the original plus carriedSince (CARRIED_Z), and a later run at LATEST leaves every kept file byte for byte as it was, first carriedSince included.
Clears on recovery: once the repo is back there is no warning, and every tab is rebuilt (generatedAt = LATEST) without carriedSince.
Scope: a normal export marks nothing. With one project's spec renamed and another's repo moved, exactly the kept tabs are marked, and the rebuilt app.git is not.
Truncated JSON, a JSON array and non-UTF-8 bytes are kept byte for byte with exit 0, and a readable kept tab beside them is still marked.
The moved project's tabs equal their last export plus carriedSince (NOW_Z) while the other project refreshes.
The four spec-derived tabs equal their last export plus carriedSince (NOW_Z).
Record shapes and conformance, including test_every_document_validates_against_its_kind, which validates the carried alpha tabs (with carriedSince) against the tab kind.
The page is unaffected: all 68 page checks pass, exit 0.
